XenotypeDef.label: anthroracc
XenotypeDef.description: Anthroraccs are a variant of anthrosonae designed to resemble an anthropomorphized raccoon. While they look quite different, generally they are functionally identical to baseliner humans.\n\nSuch xenogerms are commercially available among many spacer-tech and ultra-tech societies, often as part of an exotic fashion trend or to affirm an individual's identity. Contrary to popular belief, anthrosona genes are engineered from the ground-up without any splicing from their animal counterparts.
XenotypeDef.descriptionShort: Anthroraccs are a variant of anthrosonae designed to resemble an anthropomorphized raccoon. While they look quite different, generally they are functionally identical to baseliner humans.
